description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Josh Jacobs has been charged with two misdemeanors following an incident in May. His initial court date is set for mid-November. The NFL is conducting its own investigation, and a suspension could soon follow.
items.impact: It's important to remember that the NFL has the ability to either suspend Jacobs at the start of the season or wait until the legal process is over. If they wait, then Jacobs will likely not face suspension until next year. If not, we could be looking at a potential 6-8 game absence, though that is more of an educated guess at this point. For anyone taking Jacobs in drafts right now, Marshawn Lloyd is a must-have handcuff and is a great target for Zero-RB builds.
items.title: Josh Jacobs charged with two misdemeanors stemming from May incident

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Tutu Atwell has been traded to the Los Angeles Rams for Jarquez Hunter.
items.impact: Either the Dolphins got a good enough look at Tutu to feel fine letting him go, or the Rams are bracing for a potential Puka Nacua suspension and wanted to bring in a familiar face. Or both could be true. Either way, it's not a good look for Atwell that he made himself expendable on a team desperate for receivers. However, it's about as favorable a spot as he could've landed on.
items.title: Tutu Atwell traded to the Los Angeles Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Braden Smith suffered an injury to his plantar fascia and could miss "a few weeks."
items.impact: Smith suffered the injury in practice earlier this week. It is not considered a long-term issue, but his status for Week 1 is uncertain.
items.title: Braden Smith (plantar fascia) to miss a few weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles signed Tahj Washington.
items.impact: Miami released Washington earlier this week. He will compete for a depth role in the Eagles wide receiver room.
items.title: Tahj Washington signs with Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers restructured DK Metcalf's contract.
items.impact: The move creates nearly $18 million in cap space for Pittsburgh.
items.title: DK Metcalf restructures contract with Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed Leonard Williams to a three-year, $90 million contract extension.
items.impact: Williams has dominated in his two years since joining the Seahawks. He remains one of the top defensive lineman in football.
items.title: Leonard Williams signs three-year extension with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bears coach Ben Johnson is dealing with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Dexter did not travel with the team for their preseason finale against the Titans. His status for Week 1 is uncertain.
items.title: Gervon Dexter Sr. dealing with hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Isiah Pacheco is dealing with a back injury in addition to his MCL sprain.
items.impact: Pacheco remains without a clear timetable to return. The Lions recently worked out Kareem Hunt.
items.title: Isiah Pacheco dealing with back injury in addition to MCL sprain

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed TE Jonnu Smith to a one-year contract.
items.impact: Smith finally finds a new landing spot heading into the season. He'll add depth in the Packers tight end room behind Tucker Kraft.
items.title: Jonnu Smith signs one-year deal with Packers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Cedric Tillman was released by the Browns on Thursday.
items.impact: A third-round pick back in 2023, Tillman has failed to really do much of note for the Browns' offense over the last three seasons. The former University of Tennessee standout will now look to catch on with a different team.
items.title: Cedric Tillman released by Browns

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Alec Pierce (ankle) was activated from the PUP list on Thursday.
items.impact: Pierce has been rehabbing from surgery back in March. The big-play wideout will finally join the Colts at practice in hopes of being ready to go for Week 1. Pierce eclipsed 1,000 yards receiving for the first time in his career last season and has led the NFL in yards per catch each of the last two years.
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) activated from PUP list

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Mike Evans is planning to play in Week 1 as he continues to deal with a groin injury.
items.impact: Evans' groin injury is being described as "minor" after missing back-to-back practices this week. The veteran's status should be monitored leading up to the opening week of the regular season.
items.title: Mike Evans (groin) planning to play Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Downs did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Downs missed practice for undisclosed reasons on Tuesday and it is now said to be a calf injury. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: Josh Downs (calf) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Warren did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Warren remains likely to miss practice all of this week as he recovers from a groin injury. His status for Week 1 is not in danger yet if he can return to practice by next week.
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tucker Kraft will participate in 11-on-11 drills in the Packers joint practice with Cardinals.
items.impact: Kraft returned to team drills earlier in August. He remains on track to be good to go for Week 1 in September.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) to participate in 11-on-11 drills in joint practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Eagles.
items.impact: We will see Joe Burrow and the starters for Cincinnati back on the field in Week 1 against the Bucs.
items.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters will not play in preseason finale

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: James Conner is progressing from his foot injury, but he remains uncertain for Week 1.
items.impact: Conner's role in the Cardinals backfield remains unclear following the offseason additions of Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.
items.title: James Conner (foot) progressing, uncertain for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts have waived CB Mekhi Blackmon.
items.impact: Indianapolis acquired Blackmon last year. He appeared in all 17 games for the Colts last season with 11 starts.
items.title: Mekhi Blackmon waived by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deshaun Watson and the Browns starters will not play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Patriots.
items.impact: We will see Watson and the starters for Cleveland back on the field in Week 1 against the Jaguars.
items.title: Deshaun Watson, starters will not play Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
items.impact: We will see Young and the starters for Carolina back on the field in Week 1 against the Bears.
items.title: Bryce Young, Panthers starters will not play Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Darnell Wright returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright avoids a scare following his early exit from practice on Tuesday.
items.title: Darnell Wright (elbow) practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Luther Burden III returned to practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burden was back on the field for the first time since injuring his groin on August 8. He went through individual drills and went inside when 7 on 7 started. This should put him on track to be good to go for Week 1.
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) back at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Penix was cleared for team drills last weekend. Tua Tagovailoa will start on Friday. The starting job for Atlanta in Week 1 remains up in the air.
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. will not play Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Tagovailoa will close out the preseason against his former team. Michael Penix Jr. will not play. The starter role for Week 1 remains up in the air.
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa to start preseason finale Friday
